verdict.rationale: Helicone documents a REST request-query API (POST /v1/request/query, with a published OpenAPI spec), a one-line PostHog export, and self-hosting via Docker Compose, so users can pull their logged data out and run their own instance. A hands-on user also reports being able to see each request and 'export them all' to build a fine-tuning dataset. However, no first-party documentation describes a complete bulk export or names the open formats (e.g., CSV/JSONL) it produces. missing for 10: documented bulk export of all data (requests, sessions, prompts, settings), explicit open-format specification, documented migration/offboarding path.
